eligibility: exactly two threshold clicks across all twelve returned modes, one on a control rail (modes 0, 1) and one on a target rail (modes 2, 3)

outcomes.meaning: control rail then target rail of the click

compilation_seeds.rule: nonzero draw values in index order, repeats skipped; 144 compilation seeds in schedule order, then the bootstrap seed

preregistered.estimator: primary: linear inversion of the 144 x 4 absolute outcome rates (eligible events over the iteration's nb_shots_used) onto the 16 x 16 Choi matrix; the success probability of the postselected map may depend on the input, so the Choi matrix is trace non-increasing and carries its total rate
preregistered.rate_denominator: nb_shots_used counts detection events of at least one photon; with uniform loss the chance of at least one click is 1 - (1 - T)^2 for every setting, so eligible / nb_shots_used is an absolute rate common to all settings up to one factor per job
preregistered.process_fidelity: F_pro = <Phi_CZ| J |Phi_CZ> / (4 Tr J) for the unprojected Choi matrix J, a ratio of linear functionals of the rates; Tr J / 4 is the mean eligible rate
preregistered.descriptive_estimator: per-setting normalization to the eligible events, linear inversion, nearest completely positive trace-preserving map by Dykstra projections: the limit of this conditional reconstruction differs from the postselected fidelity because the conditional map is not linear

bootstrap.kind: parametric resample of every iteration: its samples multinomially over the four eligible outcomes and the rest, its shots as the samples plus a negative binomial count of failures at the observed sample share; the percentile interval, chosen by the coverage study in forecast.json

preregistered.binding: each returned iteration binds to the setting that has its echoed compilation_seed, one to one; each run's cases.json must equal the retained case byte for byte and the two runs must be distinct jobs; an entry that is missing, malformed or an error is counted and skipped

pooling.rule: both jobs; the rates of job-01 are multiplied by g(T_job-00) / g(T_job-01) with g(T) = T / (2 - T), the ratio of the eligible rate to the shot rate under uniform loss, T read from each run's perfs_at_plan
pooling.otherwise: the pooled estimate is reported as descriptive
pooling.incomplete: a missing setting, or a run that is not both jobs, leaves the estimate undecided
pooling.collect_timeout: job-01 is submitted only after job-00 collects a terminal status; a collect that times out is repeated once, and a second timeout stops the case with job-01 unsent

descriptive: the fidelity of the nearest positive matrix of the same trace (biased low under noise)
the least eigenvalue of J over its trace
per-setting eligible share of the two-click samples
exclusions by cause and uncounted iterations by kind
comparison with the retained noise forecast
preregistered.vendor_comparison: none: the vendor paper's 93.8 +- 0.6 % CNOT figure carries no fidelity type in docs/notes/quandela/literature.md, so the case reports no difference to it
preregistered.interpretation: service-compiled average postselected CZ; preparation, readout and gate errors are not separable because every setting compiles to its own mesh
